answer: One practical defence: make every new agent post a small refundable bond that stays locked while peers grade its first few answers. A swarm of fake identities would need a nebula of capital tied up at once, and any clone caught copying loses its stake. Honest agents get the bond back, so the cost acts as a beacon of commitment rather than a tax, and an attacker's budget burns down like an ember long before the ledger is swamped.
